cases.title: Land-ice inventory ceiling
cases.purpose: A complete-melt inventory must use the present-day grounded land-ice water equivalent; it cannot silently become a 200 m event.
cases.hard_invariant: Current land-ice equivalent and geological highstand are distinct scenario families.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Floating ice exclusion
cases.purpose: Floating sea ice and floating ice shelves must not be counted as grounded land-ice water equivalent.
cases.hard_invariant: Floating ice is not added as if it were grounded land ice.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Global mean versus local relative sea level
cases.purpose: A global mean projection cannot be rendered as a site-specific shoreline without regional processes and datum evidence.
cases.hard_invariant: Global mean and relative local sea level remain distinct quantities.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Eustatic versus relative sea level
cases.purpose: Tectonic uplift/subsidence, glacial isostatic adjustment and dynamic topography cannot be silently folded into a global eustatic estimate.
cases.hard_invariant: Every sea-level variable retains its physical reference frame.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Competing Cretaceous reconstructions
cases.purpose: Conflicting published reconstruction families are evaluated independently; no unweighted average is promoted as truth.
cases.hard_invariant: Source, method, reference datum and uncertainty remain attached to each curve.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Synthetic modern-terrain +200 m
cases.purpose: A +200 m modern-surface flood overlay is labelled an adversarial synthetic stress test, not a forecast or paleogeography.
cases.hard_invariant: Synthetic stress labels cannot be promoted to physical forecast labels.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Deep-time precision decay
cases.purpose: A 10^7–10^8 year Earth-system boundary-condition study cannot emit precise future city coordinates or asset-level design life claims.
cases.hard_invariant: Spatial and temporal claim precision degrades with horizon.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Supercontinent alternatives
cases.purpose: Alternative future supercontinent configurations remain separate Earth-system boundary-condition experiments, not city forecasts.
cases.hard_invariant: Different configurations, rotation and insolation assumptions are not collapsed.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Balanced navigation-pool reference
cases.purpose: Exact hand calculation: start 1000 m3; inflows 100+20+5 m3; outflows 30+15+10+5+20+25 m3.
cases.hard_invariant: Final storage 1020 m3; balance residual 0 m3.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Drought storage-floor violation
cases.purpose: Exact hand calculation: start 1000 m3; zero inflow/precipitation/returns; outflows total 105 m3; minimum storage 900 m3.
cases.hard_invariant: Final storage 895 m3; 5 m3 below the required minimum.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Environmental-flow shortfall
cases.purpose: Required downstream release is 25 m3 but the proposed policy releases only 20 m3.
cases.hard_invariant: A 5 m3 shortfall blocks eligibility even if navigation remains feasible.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Donor-basin transfer overdraw
cases.purpose: Transfer request is 25 m3 while donor-basin allocable surplus after prior rights and environmental flows is 20 m3.
cases.hard_invariant: The 5 m3 overdraw blocks transfer eligibility.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Leakage limit exceeded
cases.purpose: Measured leakage is 8 m3 against a declared maximum of 5 m3 over the accounting interval.
cases.hard_invariant: Leakage remains a separately measured outflow; it cannot be hidden in a catch-all residual.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Precipitation and evaporation signs
cases.purpose: Pool precipitation is +20 m3 and evaporation is -15 m3 in the same interval.
cases.hard_invariant: The net atmospheric contribution is +5 m3; sign inversion is detected.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Lockage volume and energy
cases.purpose: Four lock cycles each consume 12 m3; energy intensity is 1.5 kWh per cycle.
cases.hard_invariant: Lockage consumption is 48 m3 and lock energy is 6 kWh.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Unknown units or water authority
cases.purpose: A water ledger omits units or the source/transfer authority is unknown.
cases.hard_invariant: Unknown units, entitlement or water source cannot be inferred as zero or approved.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Single-edge gateway cut
cases.purpose: A three-node port–inland–service graph has a single bridge edge between gateway and inland services.
cases.hard_invariant: The bridge edge is a cut set of cardinality one; failure disconnects the service.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Independent gateway redundancy
cases.purpose: Two internally edge-disjoint gateway paths serve the same inland demand node.
cases.hard_invariant: Failure of either single path leaves one route available.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: False redundancy through common-mode asset
cases.purpose: Two nominal routes share one bridge, power substation or control system.
cases.hard_invariant: Parallel route count must not be mistaken for independent resilience.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Waterway seasonal closure
cases.purpose: A waterway corridor closes under low flow while a rail alternative remains capacity-constrained.
cases.hard_invariant: The model records residual unmet demand rather than silently rerouting beyond capacity.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Relocatable port terminal
cases.purpose: A coastal terminal becomes unavailable but its inland rail, dry-port and utility links can be reconnected to a replacement terminal.
cases.hard_invariant: Continuity is measured at service level, with relocation cost and downtime explicit.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Bottleneck capacity
cases.purpose: A route's delivered flow is bounded by the minimum capacity along its path.
cases.hard_invariant: No route can deliver more than its bottleneck or network min-cut.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Multiple corridor disruption
cases.purpose: A flood disables road and rail segments in a correlated hazard footprint.
cases.hard_invariant: Independent-failure assumptions cannot be used where hazard footprints are shared.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Recovery and restoration order
cases.purpose: A damaged common utility must be restored before dependent assets can resume service.
cases.hard_invariant: Restoration time follows dependency order, not just local repair durations.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Static versus staged investment
cases.purpose: Compare a one-shot build against a staged portfolio under the same total budget and scenario set.
cases.hard_invariant: A staged plan is not credited unless it improves declared outcomes or option value.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Trigger with adequate lead time
cases.purpose: A monitoring signal crosses its trigger early enough for an action to finish before the service threshold is breached.
cases.hard_invariant: Trigger, action lead time and service threshold are evaluated on one time axis.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Late trigger failure
cases.purpose: The same adaptation action is initiated after its required lead time has passed.
cases.hard_invariant: The planner cannot claim prevention after the threshold has already been crossed.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Monitoring delay and observation gaps
cases.purpose: A trigger is only observed after a declared sampling delay and missing-observation interval.
cases.hard_invariant: Unobserved hazard progression is not treated as if the policy had perfect foresight.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Adaptive policy versus fixed plan
cases.purpose: A decision tree chooses a contingent action based only on information available at that decision time.
cases.hard_invariant: No future scenario state or outcome may leak into an earlier decision.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Uncalibrated scenario probabilities
cases.purpose: Scenarios have no defensible probability distribution but an optimizer attempts expected-value scoring.
cases.hard_invariant: Uncalibrated likelihoods cannot be invented; use robust/regret analysis instead.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Minimax-regret known answer
cases.purpose: Enumerate a small action-by-scenario outcome matrix and compare the reported minimax-regret action with exhaustive enumeration.
cases.hard_invariant: The oracle is independent of production scoring and optimizer code.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Value of information versus delay
cases.purpose: A proposed study can change the selected pathway, but waiting for it can consume the action lead time.
cases.hard_invariant: Information value and the cost of waiting are both shown; neither is assumed dominant.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Bathymetry source class
cases.purpose: A GEBCO_2026 cell is classified by its Type Identifier Grid as measured, interpolated or otherwise source-qualified.
cases.hard_invariant: Nominal grid interval is not treated as observation accuracy.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Vertical datum mismatch
cases.purpose: Terrain and water levels use incompatible vertical datums without an auditable transform.
cases.hard_invariant: No silent datum assumption or implicit zero-offset transform is allowed.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Resolution and vertical uncertainty sensitivity
cases.purpose: A shoreline or route decision changes under plausible terrain-resolution and vertical-error perturbations.
cases.hard_invariant: A single raster threshold result is not reported as stable when perturbation changes the decision.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Vertical land-motion uncertainty
cases.purpose: A relative sea-level estimate omits known or unresolved subsidence/uplift context.
cases.hard_invariant: The output remains global/eustatic context until local vertical-motion evidence is added.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Water rights unknown
cases.purpose: A proposed inter-basin transfer has no verified entitlement or competent authority evidence.
cases.hard_invariant: No optimizer score can compensate for missing legal authority.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Ecological passage and sediment continuity
cases.purpose: A canal alternative severs fish passage, sediment movement or wetland connectivity without an approved mitigation/assessment basis.
cases.hard_invariant: Ecological functions are explicit constraints and outcome measures, not decorative metadata.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Distributional service floor
cases.purpose: Aggregate regional throughput improves while one affected community falls below a predeclared essential-service floor.
cases.hard_invariant: Aggregate benefit cannot compensate for a breached group-level minimum.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.

cases.title: Consent, authority and source rights
cases.purpose: A project alternative lacks required affected-party process, data rights or approval provenance.
cases.hard_invariant: Technical feasibility is not consent, legal authority or construction authorization.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-level behavior only; no real-site, physical, legal or engineering feasibility claim.
